jobDescription: A software company with offices in five countries buys cloud services, contractors and office equipment through a procure-to-pay system. Procurement operations handles purchase-request intake, keeps the approval matrix current, looks after supplier master data and reports cycle times to the finance leadership team. The analyst will triage requests, adjust approval workflows with finance, clean up supplier records and build the monthly procurement report. Cycle-time improvements are reported from system timestamps against a baseline quarter. The analyst works with the finance business partners, with the legal team on contract templates and with the IT team that administers the procure-to-pay system.
requirements: Triages purchase requests and routes them to the right buyer or category owner.
Maintains the approval matrix and approval workflows together with finance.
Shows a measured reduction in purchase-order approval time from system timestamps against a baseline quarter.
Maintains supplier master data, including duplicate removal, bank-detail change controls and annual supplier risk reviews.
Builds the monthly procurement report for finance leadership.

evidence.text: Triaged incoming purchase requests in Coupa at Northvale Software, routing each one to the category buyer and sending incomplete requests back with a checklist of the fields to complete.
Rewrote the approval matrix with the financial controller, removing two approval tiers for renewals within budget, and configured the new workflow in Coupa.
Average purchase-order approval time went from 6.8 working days in Q1 2024 to 2.9 working days in Q3 2024, measured between the request-submitted and final-approval timestamps in Coupa.
Merged 312 duplicate supplier records and applied the call-back check to every supplier bank-detail change request.
Built the monthly procurement report in Looker for the finance leadership team, covering spend by category, approval times and requests on hold.

Work sample: the approval-time analysis workbook, containing the Q1 2024 and Q3 2024 timestamp extracts, the working-day calculation excluding public holidays, the two averages (6.8 and 2.9 working days) and the financial controller's review comments.
HR verification note: employment at Northvale Software (July 2021 to the present, Procurement Operations Analyst) was confirmed in the employer's response to the screening provider's request.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate's notice period is six weeks, and the candidate asked whether the role includes travel to the Dublin office.
